# FFmpeg HEVC decoder

Unmodified FFmpeg 9.0 source archive retained for reproducible shared-library
builds. SHA-256: `7f607a00dd0d28a729d5a4811205812eef01cf6ef6155025febb6f36a9062d52`.

Built with GPL/nonfree disabled, HEVC decoder, avcodec/avutil/swscale only.
The LGPL libraries are separate, replaceable APK shared libraries. See
`scripts/build-video.sh` for full build options. Original source notices and
licenses are included in the archive. JNI glue/compositor lives in native-app.
